g.text: Realm: Node Attestation, Transparent Egress and SPIFFE Identity

text.tspan: lo + realm0 dummy / No external link or default route
Proxies use host networking / Workloads keep separate ns

g.text: Workload B: private backend network namespace

text.tspan: Isolated native services and supported rootless containers enroll automatically; host-network / external workloads stay outside capture.
Root controller enforces local attribution; the worker opens only existing declared Unix egress sockets.
Ghostunnel and native gateways retain SPIFFE authentication and receiver allowlists. DNS supplies location, not identity.
Node bootstrap uses HTTP FQDN proofs over the registry-pinned mesh; that HTTP path must be trusted because it adds no encryption.
Solid links: requests. Dashed links: control / identity. Backend workloads can use the same capture path as workload A.
Same netns / Own resource cgroup + minimal root
Unix ingress socket for TCP backend
Gateways with their own mutual TLS
One daemon / Gate pins peer with pidfd
Native unit binding / Exclusive container UID
Local SPIRE Agent on each host
Node identity: HTTP FQDN proof with registry pins
Issues workload identity by systemd unit + Unix user
Publishes proof through a root-only Unix socket
Loopback TCP or declared Unix socket

g.text: Declared route or Internet CONNECT / DNS DoH
Attach BPF to attested app cgroup
Enter netns, isolate mounts/resources, drop UID
